additional_info.subject: ID0390762-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P8 160368794] DoorPositionSwitch fault CRM:00798001505
additional_info.body:
Hi Simen,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
Kople AS
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / N8 160368794
Charger ID/Serial No.:
iErdFx
Problem Description:
DoorPositionSwitch fault
We have investigated the Charger, We have found the following error flags:
DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 & SafetyRelay_QA26
Pls refer KA for
SafetyRelay_QA26 Error :
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_HW_QA26_MCCB failure in feedback line
For
DoorPositionSwitch_BG3_BG4 Error :
We need to plan for the Site intervention and check if the BG3 and BG4 switches are fixed at its place or they are moving.
if it is moving we need to fix it at the place.
If they are fixed, We need to validate if the switch is functioning properly, if not we need to have spares, and consider replacing same.
It is fine, We need to troubleshoot further as per below schematic.
We need to ensure the connections are XD34 and XD9.1 & XD9.2 are intact.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 8/7/2023, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com

rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Thank and Best Regards,
